integrity: The phase classification is proved analytically from the restricted likelihood. The discriminant specialization is used only as a cross-check. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the reflection-symmetric data line and the corresponding three-coordinate positive-model slice of \(\operatorname{Gr}(2,4)\); no classification of off-slice critical points or higher \(n\) is claimed.
title: Exact \(1/\sqrt{2}\) likelihood bifurcation on the symmetric \(\operatorname{Gr}(2,4)\) slice
